handbookNote: Michigan Real Estate Salesperson license exam. RECONSTRUCTED CONFIG: this track's original build session did not leave a local track-config/questionsDir on this machine -- the 118 live questions existed only in D1. For this pool-depth backfill pass (2026-08-31), the 118 live questions were exported directly from D1 and split by their existing 'topic' column into 5 bucket files under mi_re_salesperson_questions/ (Advertising/Supervision & Property Interest Disclosure 17, Contractual Relationships: Service & Right-to-List Agreements 16, Definitions/Duties & Agency Relationship Disclosure 22, Licensing/Applications & Department Requirements 42, Prohibited Conduct/Trust Accounts & Compensation 21) to serve as inventory/style reference for backfill agents. Regulatory framework: same as the parallel mi_re_broker track built this session (same statute, different licensure tier) -- Occupational Code Article 25 (MCL 339.2501-339.2518) and the Michigan Administrative Code Real Estate Brokers and Salespersons General Rules (R 339.22101-339.22667), administered by LARA with PSI Services LLC as exam vendor. CONFIRMED via the same official PSI Candidate Information Bulletin used for mi_re_broker (updated 10/8/2024): the Salesperson exam is 115 scored questions, 70% passing (80 raw score), 180 minutes -- a DIFFERENT exam from the Broker exam (115 questions/75%/90 raw/210 min), confirmed distinct per the bulletin's own Examination Summary Table. This track_registry entry (exam_question_count=40, pass_percent=70) reflects the currently-tracked Michigan-specific portion. Bucket agents should independently verify current statute section numbers via live fetch of legislature.mi.gov rather than assuming, though many real MCL 339.25xx citations are already confirmed in the mi_re_broker.json handbookNote from this same session and can be reused where genuinely applicable to the salesperson tier (note: salesperson qualifications differ from broker's -- MCL 339.2503 salesperson-specific age/education requirements are DIFFERENT from MCL 339.2504/339.2505's broker-specific 90-hour/3-year requirements, so do not assume the broker figures apply here without independent verification). Price set at $29.99 (2999 cents) to match this project's standardized Real Estate track rate. Backfill new-question IDs use prefix 'mi_re_salesperson-deepen1-*', which will not collide with the original IDs already in D1.
